title: Marlowe 2025: Oracle Protocol, Design and Implementation

ms.promise:
To formally define the Marlowe Oracle Protocol and ensure its acceptance and understanding within the Cardano community, a detailed Cardano Improvement Proposal (CIP) must be submitted. To fully support Oracle functionality, we need to adapt the existing Marlowe validator and runtime backend to handle Oracle data interactions efficiently and securely.
Formalize Marlowe Oracle Specification

・Initial formal specification for Marlowe Oracle Protocol is documented and iterated via CIP submission and stakeholder feedback
・Specification to include rationale and objectives for the protocol, technical requirements, functionality and integration points with and dependency on the existing Marlowe infrastructure.
・Draft CIP proposal submitted to the Cardano Improvement Proposal repository
・Details of the structure of the CIP are provided in the acceptance criteria below.
・Feedback collected from Stakeholder engagement with Oracle service providers (e.g., Wolfram Blockchain Labs, Charlie3, Orcfax)
・Feedback will be gathered through questionnaires and online meetings with representatives of Oracle service providers.

Marlowe Validator and Runtime Adaptations

・Document the format used in Marlo
ms.criteria:
Formalize Marlowe Oracle Specification

・Formal specification is written and includes:
・Protocol overview and purpose
・General description of system functionality
・All data definitions, including message formats and data structures
・All protocol states, including message sequences and flow control
・Error handling, including exception management
・Security considerations, including authorizations and encryption
・Interface requirements, including API details and communication channels
・Testing and validation procedures
・Suggested metadata description for oracle datapoints.
・Definitions of key ter
